title: 第23章 一个月三十两银子拼什么命第24章 天道宗请大家看一场烟花
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
天际，飞来黑压压的一群人。
他们衣袍上，绣有一个石头般的图案，每一人都带着肃杀之气。
特别是最前面一群人，无需飞剑、葫芦等御器飞行，凌空虚踏，一举一动之间都带着威势！
天空被乌云遮蔽，雷霆闪电交错纵横，狂风呼啸而来，吹的树木沙沙作响。
“天呐，怎么回事，怎么天空突然黑压压一片，这是要打雷劈人吗？”
“嘶.......那个旗帜......是灵琅宗的人！”
“我的天，凌空飞行，那些都是筑基大修士！”
“十几位筑基，灵琅宗这是全军出动了啊！”
“天道宗，能扛住吗？”
“好恐怖的威势.........”
众人抬头望天，一个个吓得脸色惨白，浑身颤抖，跪倒在地。
“嗯？这就是天道宗？好浓郁的灵气！”
灵琅宗队伍最前方，灵琅轩眯着双眸，环顾了一番四周。
这里的灵气比他们灵琅宗还要浓郁数倍，如果在这里修炼，必定事半功倍。
“此地灵气之浓郁，超乎寻常，恐怕其地下应有灵脉滋养！”
灵琅轩身旁一位老者，眼神犀利如刀，扫视着四周，眼中露出一抹火热之色。
灵脉啊！
这绝对是难以想象的至宝！
灵琅轩听闻之后，同样双眼放光，不由得贪婪的盯着这天道宗山头。
“哈哈哈.......！”

灵琅轩忍不住仰天长啸！
“天助我也！”
如果他能夺到此地的灵脉，必将实力大涨，甚至有很大希望冲击金丹真人境界！
入了金丹境，才是步入了大陆真正的强者之列！
即使到了大赵皇宫，也要被尊称一位真人！
即使到了灵霄宗与云天宗这样的仙盟五百强，也会成为座上宾！
“灵脉？”
“足以撑起一个大宗门的坚强底蕴！”
“若黄泉门有此灵脉，崛起指日可待啊！”
灵琅宗身后，跟着众人方圆数百里内的各大宗门强者，一个个目露精光的凝视着天道宗山头。
灵脉，这东西可遇不可求。
“灵脉，我要它属于我！”
content_en:
From the sky, a dark group of people flew towards them.
There was a stone-like pattern embroidered on their robes, and each of them had a murderous air.
Especially the group of people at the front, they do not need flying swords, gourds and other royal weapons to fly, they are flying in the air, and their every move is full of power!
The sky was covered by dark clouds, with thunder and lightning crisscrossing, and strong winds roaring, rustling the trees.
"Oh my god, what's going on? Why did the sky suddenly turn black? Is this going to strike someone with lightning?"
"Hiss...that flag...is from the Linglang Sect!"
"Oh my god, flying in the sky, those are all foundation-building monks!"
"More than a dozen foundation builders, Linglang Sect's entire army is dispatched!"
"Tiandaozong, can you handle it?"
"What a terrifying power..."
Everyone looked up at the sky, their faces turned pale with fear, their whole bodies were shaking, and they fell to their knees.
"Huh? This is Tiandao Sect? Such rich spiritual energy!"
At the front of the Linglang Sect team, Linglangxuan squinted his eyes and looked around.
The spiritual energy here is several times richer than that of their Linglang Sect. If you practice here, you will get twice the result with half the effort.
"The spiritual energy here is so rich that it's extraordinary. I'm afraid there should be spiritual veins nourishing it underground!"
There was an old man next to Linglangxuan, his eyes as sharp as knives, scanning the surroundings with a fiery look in his eyes.
Spiritual veins!
This is definitely an unimaginable treasure!
After hearing this, Linglangxuan's eyes also shone, and he couldn't help but stare greedily at the top of the Tiandaozong Mountain.
"Hahaha...!"
Linglangxuan couldn't help but look up to the sky and roar!
"God help me!"
If he can seize the spiritual veins here, his strength will be greatly increased, and he may even have great hope of reaching the realm of Jindan Zhenren!
Only when you enter the Golden Core Realm can you enter the ranks of the true powerhouses in the mainland!
Even when you arrive at the Great Zhao Palace, you must be honored as a real person!
Even if they reach the top 500 of the Immortal Alliance such as Lingxiao Sect and Yuntian Sect, they will become guests!
"Spiritual veins?"
"Strong enough to support a large sect!"
"If Huangquan Sect has this spiritual vein, its rise will be just around the corner!"
Behind Linglang Sect, there were powerful men from various sects within a radius of several hundred miles, all staring at the top of Tiandao Sect's mountain with bright eyes.
Spiritual veins, this thing is hard to come by.
"Spiritual vein, I want it to be mine!"
